title: Boots of Apparent Death

sources.title: Feign Death
markers: | description = Put an ally in a protective coma. They become [[Resistant]] to all damage except {{DamageType|Psychic}}. [[Diseased (status group)|Disease]] and [[Poisoned (status group)|poison]] no longer have any effect.

summary: Once per Short Rest, use an Action on an ally within 5 ft to put them in a protective coma for 10 turns. They resist all damage except Psychic, and disease and poison effects are suppressed. Help ends the effect.

fields.Effect: Once per Short Rest, use an Action on an ally within 5 ft to put them in a protective coma for 10 turns. They resist all damage except Psychic, and disease and poison effects are suppressed. Help ends the effect.
fields.Base value: 190 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay use and reviewed pinned source evidence.
